notes.title: "GUROBU" new short horror game release!
notes.notes:
Hello, I'm excited to announce that I'm releasing a new game
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1383850/Gurobu/]"GUROBU"[/url], which is a short experimental horror game about the haunting apartment featuring surreal dream sequences.

It releases just in two weeks, on August 14th!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1383850/Gurobu/]WISHLIST HERE![/url]

notes.title: ver. 1.03 Improved endings, visuals, bug fixes.
notes.notes:
- Visuals for the final confrontation has been improved!

- Several endings have been changed. (new dialogues, maps, and visuals)

- New traditional save system.



Bug fixes:

- Now you can't escape the chase scene just by using the door at the beginning.

- Glitched save point has been removed.

- Dash isn't available from the beginning anymore.

- other minor bug fixes/typos etc.
